checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: All three are the same landscape frame, about 640x384 (5:3). None is square, 4:5 or 9:16.
The same red car appears in all three.
The whole car is visible, but only because the frame is the original landscape one.
The car looks unchanged apart from a slightly redrawn plate.

must.item: Padding is blurred source photo, no text
must.why: No text is added. There is no padding at all. The whole background is blurred, and the sharp trees and houses are gone, so the photo is altered rather than padded.

faults.what: All three outputs have the same landscape ratio (about 5:3) instead of 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16, so the core request is not met.
The three images are nearly identical, so they are not three distinct sizes.
The original background was blurred everywhere, with a tilt-shift look, instead of being kept sharp with blurred padding added.
The plate and badge are slightly redrawn.
The reply claims the images are in the requested ratios, and they are not.

summary: The agent returned three near-identical landscape images with a blurred background, not the requested 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 sizes, so the main request failed.
